annotations.title: Wallet balance: ETH and USDC of an address

description: Wallet balance of any EVM address: the native coin (ETH, POL) and USDC on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon in one call, read live, with the USDC total. Use to check what a wallet holds before a payment or to confirm funds arrived. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: balance_wallet
